ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle AOB$ is a right angle, $\angle AOC = 40^\circ$, and $OD$ bisects $\angle BOC$. What is the measure of $\angle AOD$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Because $\angle BOC = \angle AOB - \angle AOC$, \\
therefore $\angle BOC = 90^\circ - 40^\circ = 50^\circ$, \\
Because OD bisects $\angle BOC$, \\
therefore $\angle COD = \frac{1}{2}\angle BOC = \frac{1}{2} \times 50^\circ = 25^\circ$, \\
therefore $\angle AOD = \angle AOC + \angle COD = 40^\circ + 25^\circ = \boxed{65^\circ}$.
